QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Fragments from a Broken Star
QuestInfo.0: Your work in defeating the Cerebes and Bains have paid off. Krag can hear Scadur fine now. Ask Krag what it was.\r\n
QuestInfo.1:
According to Scadur, Alcaster needs star fragments for his research. It seems you can get them from any monsters in the Dead Mine. 

Collect fragments and return to #bAlcaster#k in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: Your collection of stars made Alcaster extremely happy. You've done the Star Force work that can be done in the Dead Mine.\r\n\r\n

0.0: Just now, while you were foolin' around, Scadur whistled me all the latest news. Turns out, Alcaster thinks the monsters in the Dead Mine gobbled down some #bBroken Star Fragments#k. He's gonna need #b40#k of those fragments for his research. Since my weapon doesn't work on them, this job's on you. \r\n

yes.0: Any monster in the Dead Mine might've ate some up. Head back to #bAlcaster#k once you have #b40 fragments#k.\r\n

no.0: You just let me know if you change your mind.\r\n

yes.0: This will be a huge help for my research! I'm about 40% certain of that! \r\n
